title: Aloe-emodin ameliorates non-alcoholic fatty liver disease by regulating the ZNRF3/Wnt/beta-catenin axis and suppressing hepatic lipogenesis.
authors: Li, Wenjuan; Pan, Meimin; Tang, Jinfeng
one_liner_zh: 研究芦荟大黄素通过ZNRF3/Wnt/β-catenin轴改善非酒精性脂肪肝，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is a highly prevalent metabolic disorder with limited approved pharmacological treatment options, creating an urgent need for novel therapeutic agents. This study investigated the efficacy and underlying molecular mechanism of aloe-emodin, a natural anthraquinone from Rhei Radix et Rhizoma, in treating NAFLD. In a high-fat diet (HFD)-induced mouse model, aloe-emodin administration significantly reduced body and liver weight, ameliorated hepatic steatosis, lowered serum ALT and hepatic lipid levels, and suppressed the expression of key lipogenic genes. These protective effects were recapitulated in an in vitro model using free fatty acid (FFA)-treated hepatocytes, where aloe-emodin reduced intracellular lipid accumulation without affecting cell viability. Mechanistic investigation revealed that aloe-emodin restored AMPK activation, increased PPARalpha-associated fatty acid oxidation markers, and suppressed Wnt/beta-catenin signaling. Functional rescue experiments further supported the involvement of the ZNRF3-Wnt/beta-catenin axis in the anti-lipogenic effects of aloe-emodin. Molecular docking identified ZNRF3, a critical negative regulator of the Wnt pathway, as the top potential binding target for aloe-emodin. We confirmed that ZNRF3 expression, which was downregulated in NAFLD models, was significantly restored by aloe-emodin treatment. Crucially, rescue experiments demonstrated that the therapeutic and anti-lipogenic effects of aloe-emodin were abolished both in vivo and in vitro when ZNRF3 was genetically knocked down or when the Wnt pathway was pharmacologically activated. These findings suggest that aloe-emodin ameliorates NAFLD, at least in part, by restoring ZNRF3 expression and suppressing Wnt/beta-catenin pathway-associated lipogenic activation.
abstract_zh: 非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）是一种高度流行的代谢性疾病，目前获批的药物治疗方案有限，因此亟需新型治疗药物。本研究探讨了大黄中的天然蒽醌类化合物芦荟大黄素（aloe-emodin）在治疗NAFLD中的疗效及其潜在分子机制。在高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的小鼠模型中，芦荟大黄素给药显著降低了体重和肝脏重量，改善了肝脂肪变性，降低了血清ALT和肝脏脂质水平，并抑制了关键脂肪生成基因的表达。这些保护效应在游离脂肪酸（FFA）处理的肝细胞体外模型中也得到了重现，芦荟大黄素在不影响细胞活力的前提下减少了细胞内脂质积累。机制研究表明，芦荟大黄素恢复了AMPK激活，增加了PPARα相关的脂肪酸氧化标志物，并抑制了Wnt/β-catenin信号通路。功能拯救实验进一步支持ZNRF3-Wnt/β-catenin轴参与芦荟大黄素的抗脂肪生成作用。分子对接将ZNRF3（Wnt通路的关键负调控因子）鉴定为芦荟大黄素的潜在首要结合靶点。我们确认，在NAFLD模型中下调的ZNRF3表达，经芦荟大黄素处理后显著恢复。关键的是，拯救实验表明，当ZNRF3被基因敲低或Wnt通路被药理学激活时，芦荟大黄素的治疗和抗脂肪生成效应在体内和体外均被消除。这些发现表明，芦荟大黄素至少部分通过恢复ZNRF3表达和抑制Wnt/β-catenin通路相关的脂肪生成激活来改善NAFLD。
